name: design-gate-guard
description: PreToolUse Bash gate for the brainstorming HARD-GATE — asks the user before a new-project scaffold command (npm create vite, create-next-app, cargo new, rails new, django-admin startproject, …) so the model can't jump to implementation before a design is approved. Stateless and fail-open; add design-gate:ack to the command to proceed after approval.
